v1.0.3 — Reliable ad-blocking for provider playback

Security — the fix you'll actually feel:
Ad-blocking now holds through the Play click. Previously, ads reappeared right when the provider's video started playing. Root cause: the in-page protection relied on a CDP-injected script that died the moment the provider navigated cross-site (the Play action swaps the renderer process).

Replaced with a session-level preload that runs at document-start in every frame, re-applies itself in each new renderer process, and cannot be removed by the page. Canvas/WebGL fingerprinting spoofed, crypto-miners and background workers blocked, tracking beacons and storage keys filtered, and ad-container elements hidden.

CDP is now a verification layer only — it confirms protections are active in every live frame and logs loudly if anything is missing.

Bug fixes:
Removed a full-width dark overlay that appeared over the top of Server 1's player (plus a smaller stray overlay on Server 6). These were band-aid divs never intended for Server 1 — the player area is now clean.

Under the hood:
Fixed a post-build step so the shared security package resolves correctly at runtime (this is what let the preload load). Removed dead code (old video-window path, legacy protection scripts, a stale backup file).

What's Changed:
StreamGuide custom video player with seek optimization
Smoother video controls and enhanced playback experience
Performance improvements and bug fixes
Bug fixes: removed native menu bar, fixed missing CSS styling, custom app icon, and auto-update support.

Initial desktop release. Browse movies and TV shows with the same great FilmSnaps experience — now native on desktop. Secure video player window with 6-layer security protection: ad blocking, popup blocking, navigation guards, session isolation, and resource monitoring.
